audit.why: Content whys[] correctly describe early Janna advantage (mobility dodges Q), mid Xerath poke dominance from level 3, and late Janna disengage/cleanse swing back, matching the 50.73% win rate and TRICKY diff.
Spikes correctly name level 2 tempo, level 6 R+E stun-chain burst, first item Luden's/Liandry's poke peak, late Redemption/Mikael/Monsoon disengage.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text calls Xerath's ult 'Rite of the Ancients' — the real name (per enemyAbilities) is Rite of the Arcane. Also full-layer phases[N].side disagrees with content win[N] on all 7 rows: rows 0/1/6 say Xerath/Skill where win[]=Janna, and rows 2-5 say Skill where win[]=Xerath, with their why-text still praising Janna's shields/chip instead of Xerath's poke advantage.
audit.why: enemyAbilities.R = 'Rite of the Arcane' directly from Riot Data Dragon. Chart rows 2-5 (win[]='Xerath') had generic full-layer why text ('shield the trades', 'chip and shield the margins') that doesn't name Xerath's actual level 3-5 poke advantage described correctly in content.whys.
audit.corrected: Fix 'Rite of the Ancients' to 'Rite of the Arcane'. Set phases[0/1/6].side to Janna (matching win[]; why already correct). Set phases[2-5].side to Xerath (matching win[]) and rewrite their why to state the specific Xerath-favoring interaction from the kit (charged Q outrange, W slow + E stun bully, R+E stun-chain burst, Luden's/Liandry's poke peak).

edits.before: Xerath's R Rite of the Ancients fires three long-range barrages, so hold Monsoon to peel your ADC out of the AoE and don't let a stun-into-ult chain land uninterrupted.
edits.after: Xerath's R Rite of the Arcane fires long-range barrages, so hold Monsoon to peel your ADC out of the AoE and don't let a stun-into-ult chain land uninterrupted.

edits.before: Full kit: shield the trades, slow the answers, and break the first real engage with Q.
edits.after: His charged Q Arcanopulse (9-5s CD by rank) out-ranges everything in your kit now.

edits.before: Chip and shield the margins — every broken engage is a won trade your carry banks.
edits.after: His W Eye of Destruction slow plus E stun bully you off every CS-protect walk-up.

edits.before: Monsoon online — dives on your duo now end in a healing field they paid for.
edits.after: His R barrage plus E stun-chain can burst your ADC clean from screen-range.

edits.before: First item: shields grow and the disengage toolkit compounds.
edits.after: Luden's/Liandry's poke is lane-ending here — hardest to survive.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and the artillery never converts. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your Q Howling Gale answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun, 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s CD): his only CC — dodge it and the artillery combo never converts, read it before every step-up. - Your Q Howling Gale (14s CD) answers one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.

edits.before: Auto the carry, W the support, shield the answer — chip trades the wind referees.
edits.after: Weave through minions on his poke — your kit doesn't out-range his siege, so don't try.

edits.before: Burning Q on poke and meeting the real engage with a shrug — the tornado is the matchup.
edits.after: Trading shields into his poke window just funds the mana for his next long-range volley.

notes: Fixed a real ability-name error: Xerath's R is Rite of the Arcane, not Rite of the Ancients (packet.defects was empty for this matchup, so lint missed it — caught by cross-checking enemyAbilities directly).
